content.title: Book Recommendation: Dune by Frank Herbert
content.body:
## Summary
Dune by Frank Herbert features incredible worldbuilding and lives up to its status as a sci-fi classic.

## Notable Features
- Complex blend of politics, religion, ecology, and technology
- Influential work that has shaped science fiction since its publication in 1965
- Rich world-building with detailed cultural and ecological systems
- Exploration of themes including power, religion, and human potential

## Notes
Herbert created not just a story but an entire universe with its own ecology, religions, political systems, and technologies. The depth of thought put into the planetary ecosystem of Arrakis and the cultural practices of its inhabitants remains impressive decades after publication.
